resources.string: Sign in to sync with MAL
Changes are saved on this device. They will sync automatically when internet is available. Multiple edits to one anime count as one pending change.
No local list changes are waiting to sync. Refresh to fetch changes made on MAL.
Your session expired. Pending changes are kept on this device. Sign back in to the same MAL account to deliver them.
MAL rejected a pending change. It is still kept locally. Correct the anime’s status, progress or score, or retry after resolving the issue.
Your local changes are safe. Check your connection and try again.
%d changes have not reached MAL. Signing out clears this account’s cached list and pending changes from this device. Stay signed in and retry sync to keep them.
Previous progress, status and score restored
Could not restore the previous values. Try Undo again.
The entry or account has changed. Previous values were not restored.
Sign in to MAL in the app to save this episode.
Could not update progress. Open the anime to check its status.
Choose up to four tools for the Schedule page. Use the arrows to change their order. Changes save immediately.
